program-deploy.title: Deploy Solana Program
program-deploy.sourceDirTooltip: Choose or enter the local Solana/Anchor program source directory. The app scans target/verifiable, target/deploy, .keys, Anchor.toml, and release metadata, then fills the deployment form.
program-deploy.sourceDirPickerUnavailable: Use the folder picker in the sol-safekey desktop app, or paste the source directory path manually
program-deploy.sourceDirPickerError: Failed to open the folder picker
program-deploy.sourceDirRequired: Enter a source directory path first
program-deploy.sourceImportSuccess: Deployment information was loaded from the source directory
program-deploy.sourceBuildStarted: Build started; deployment information will load automatically when it finishes
program-deploy.sourceBuildSuccess: Build finished and deployment information was loaded
program-deploy.sourceBuildTimeout: Build is still running. Import the source directory again later to check the result
program-deploy.sourceImportError: Failed to import the source directory
program-deploy.sourceAutoReadingHint: Looking for the compiled .so and program keypair automatically. Deployment readiness will update when loading finishes.
program-deploy.compileRequiredHint: No deployable .so or program keypair was loaded. Build and import first; the deploy button will enable when the artifacts are ready.
program-deploy.programFileTooltip: Select the compiled Solana SBF program (.so) to deploy, up to 3 MiB. Use the audited, reproducibly built artifact.
program-deploy.uploadedProgramSha256Tooltip: The app computes this SHA-256 locally from the selected .so for comparison with the approved value; no manual entry is needed.
program-deploy.approvedProgramSha256Tooltip: Paste the 64-character SHA-256 confirmed by a trusted release record or independent build. It must exactly match the uploaded file hash.
program-deploy.approvedProgramSha256Placeholder: Paste the SHA-256 reproduced and approved by the second operator
program-deploy.approvedProgramHashRequired: Enter the approved 64-character SHA-256 from the release record
program-deploy.approvedProgramHashMismatch: The uploaded .so SHA-256 does not match the release record
program-deploy.programHashUnavailable: The .so SHA-256 could not be computed securely. Use the local desktop app or a secure browser context
program-deploy.programKeypairFileTooltip: Select the 64-byte Solana keypair JSON generated for the new program. It determines the program address and signs account creation; treat it as secret key material.
program-deploy.derivedProgramIdTooltip: This is the on-chain program address derived from the uploaded keypair's public key. Verify it against build, client, and audit records before deploying.
program-deploy.programKeypairTooLarge: Program keypair JSON must not exceed 4 KiB
program-deploy.invalidProgramKeypair: Program keypair must be a Solana JSON array containing exactly 64 byte values
program-deploy.expectedProgramIdTooltip: The app derives and locks this target address from the program keypair. The backend verifies it again to prevent deployment to an unintended address.
program-deploy.expectedProgramIdPlaceholder: Generated after a program keypair is selected
program-deploy.expectedProgramIdMismatch: Expected Program ID does not match the uploaded program keypair
program-deploy.deploymentWalletTooltip: This wallet pays deployment rent and transaction fees and becomes the program's Upgrade Authority. Verify its address and balance before deploying.
program-deploy.expectedUpgradeAuthorityTooltip: The Upgrade Authority expected on the ProgramData account after deployment. With a saved wallet, this is filled from that wallet and verified before and after deployment.
program-deploy.expectedUpgradeAuthorityPlaceholder: Enter the upgrade authority that must remain after deployment
program-deploy.expectedUpgradeAuthorityMismatch: Expected upgrade authority does not match the selected deployment wallet
program-deploy.expectedGenesisHashTooltip: The unique Genesis Hash of the selected Solana network. The RPC must return this exact value, preventing deployment to the wrong network.
program-deploy.maxDataLenTooltip: The maximum program bytes reserved in the ProgramData account. Blank uses the current .so size; extra capacity supports larger future versions but increases rent, up to 3 MiB.
program-deploy.resumeBufferAddressTooltip: Enter the Buffer address only when resuming an interrupted deployment. Leave it blank for a new deployment; ownership, authority, length, and written bytes are verified.
program-deploy.resumeBufferAddressPlaceholder: Paste the Buffer address from the previous failure
program-deploy.invalidResumeBufferAddress: The resume Buffer address is invalid
program-deploy.journalTooltip: The app stores local progress by network, program address, file hash, and Upgrade Authority. After an interruption, refresh the record to reuse the existing Buffer.
program-deploy.journalEmpty: No persisted recovery record exists for this deployment target.
program-deploy.journalNotReady: Select a wallet, .so file, and program keypair before loading recovery state
program-deploy.journalLoadError: Failed to read the deployment record
program-deploy.journalRpcUnavailableHint: Deployment record lookup failed. The build result is unchanged; deployment requires the selected network RPC to be reachable
program-deploy.journalInvalid: The deployment record does not match the selected cluster, program, artifact, or Upgrade Authority
program-deploy.journalIntentMismatch: The recovery Buffer and max data length must match the persisted deployment intent
program-deploy.journalWriteBreakdown: Confirmed {confirmed}; finalized {finalized}; processing {processing}; {bytes} bytes per chunk
program-deploy.journalSlowConfirmationHint: No new confirmation for a while. The RPC may be slow or the request may be waiting too long; the local recovery record is saved, so refresh the record and resume deployment safely.
program-deploy.journalStalledToast: Deployment has not progressed for a while, so the foreground loading state was released. Refresh the deployment record and continue with the recovery Buffer.
program-deploy.journalAutoRefreshing: Deployment request is running; refreshing progress automatically...
program-deploy.journalCreateLastValid: Create Buffer last valid block height: {blockHeight}
program-deploy.journalWriteEvidence: Recorded chunk: {index}; last valid block height: {blockHeight}
program-deploy.journalBufferFilled: The persisted Buffer and max data length were filled into the recovery fields
